summary: Key NKE news this week: (1) Dividend declared $0.41/share for Class A+B, payable July 1 to holders of record June 1; (2) Second layoff round in 2026 — ~1,400 roles (2% of global workforce), majority in tech; (3) 'Win Now' restructuring strategy ongoing, supply chain shifts; (4) Guidance: expects 2%-4% sales decline this quarter due to weak Greater China and Converse; (5) FY2026 EPS consensus ~$1.51, down ~30% YoY.
